title: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
requirement: Landlords of units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance are limited to an annual rent increase of 3% for the period of July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026.
coverage_conditions: rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.

title: Utility Surcharge Prohibition
requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords are prohibited from including any additional percentage increase for utilities in the rent.
coverage_conditions: rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

title: State law notice requirement
requirement: Landlords must provide 30 days' written advance notice for rent increases of less than 10%.
quoted_span: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
